migration.strategy: versioned user-state schema with dry-run validation before replacement
migration.failure_action: leave current installation and user state untouched

update.strategy: download to staging, verify SHA-256 and Authenticode, then atomic directory promotion

rollback.strategy: retain one verified previous version and atomically restore it

dependencies.strategy: preflight supported external Blender and Godot versions; do not silently mutate system installs
